name: eyespy-workspace
description: eyespy: find and catalogue the objects in a video, locally in your browser or on your machine

scripts.test: pnpm --filter eyespy-core test && pnpm --filter eyespy-web test && pnpm --filter eyespy test && pnpm --filter eyespy-server test && node --test tools/eslint/*.test.js
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm deps:check && pnpm knip && pnpm test && pnpm licenses:check
scripts.deps:check: depcruise core server/src server/scripts cli/src web/src web/scripts web/vite.config.ts
scripts.deps:graph: mkdir -p scratch && depcruise core/src server/src cli/src web/src --include-only "^(core|server|cli|web)/" -T archi | dot -Tsvg -o scratch/deps.svg
